Fix scoring system: Apply penalty points for wrong picks

- Fixed episode-results route to properly apply -3 point penalties
- Star Baker pick gets eliminated: -3 points
- Elimination pick wins Star Baker: -3 points
- Now consistent with main scoring calculation logic
- Maximum weekly loss is 6 points (both picks wrong)

- Use style={{color: '#000000'}} instead of Tailwind classes
- This should override any CSS conflicts and force pure black color
- Apply to both dashboard and user-dashboard leaderboards

- Improve overall UI consistency and user experience

- Create dedicated WhatsApp sharing admin page

- Add Leaderboard component to user dashboard

- Real-time leaderboard updates using Server-Sent Events

Components created:

Initial commit - GBBO Fantasy League App ready for production

Static Decrypto Dealer — single HTML file, no server needed

Vanilla JS app that acts as a digital dealer for Decrypto:
- 420-word pool, 4 words per team, no overlap
- Shuffled 24-permutation code decks per team
- Reveal/hide keywords, pop codes on bright red card
- Deployable as a static site on Vercel or GitHub Pages
